turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's it going? You doing okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I found a laptop I like but there are two versions.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Let me guess, more memory or more storage? One has sixteen gigs of memory and the other has a bigger drive. Which do you think you'd miss more?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I have a call coming in. I'll come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, you cut out there. Okay, you're back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I said I'll be there at seven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you pick up some bread on the way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, off the phone. Sorry about that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hope the call went okay. Still weighing memory against storage on that laptop?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Memory. I always have a million browser tabs open.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then memory is the right call. You can always add an external drive later.
